paragraphs: On Saturday morning, the Explorers stood in a big hall with Teacher Kim. A woman with a long black ponytail and a name badge came to them. "Hello, I am Guide Ann," she said. "Today I give you a tour." "Please stay with me, and do not touch the red buttons." Leo looked at the ceiling. "There is a rocket above us!" he said.

"It is a model of a rocket," said Guide Ann. "A rocket for space is much bigger." "Turn left, please, and come into the next room." On the left, there was a long table with a small railway. "Look!" said Mia. "The small train is at the platform, and the small people are waiting." Guide Ann smiled. "Push the green button, Mia," she said. The train went through a tunnel and came out at the end.

In the next room, a red racing car stood in the middle. "Can I sit in it?" asked Leo. "Yes, but we do not drive it," said Guide Ann. "If you push the pedal, a light shows how the engine works." Leo sat in the car and pushed the pedal. A small light came on inside the engine. "It is bright!" he said. May asked, "What is your job here, Guide Ann?" "I tell people about science, and I answer their questions," said Guide Ann.

After the tour, the children sat on the grass outside the hall. "Lily, you write the blog," said Teacher Kim. "Do not write the name of the place at first." "Let other people guess." Lily wrote, "We saw a rocket, a railway, and a racing car." "A guide gave us a tour. Where are we?" "That is easy," said Mia. "Everyone can guess it." "I hope so," said Lily, and she put the post on Explorers' Blog.
text.summary: The Explorers go on a tour with Guide Ann. They see a rocket, a model railway, and a racing car, and Lily writes a blog post for the readers to guess where the children are.
